usedFor: Urable holds the jobs and customers, and Google Drive shares a file after “When a job is completed”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a job is completed” in Urable, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A completed job is the end of the work, so the related file can be shared then.

watchOut: Urable triggers are polling, so “Share File With Anyone” runs after a scheduled check.
